bio: OAK’s younger sibling is hip and friendly. The handsome mosaic tiled floor and open kitchen first draw the eye, before you sit down to sample the Greek-born chef’s Mediterranean fare. You can choose between three types of menu: Comfort, Trust and Discover, featuring a range of international, unusual and deftly crafted dishes to share, such as his fascinating Holstein tonnato 2.0! Expect to be surprised!...
